items.question: Whether exemption from GST has been claimed on any particular transaction?
-If yes, pls list down nature/description of outward supply on which GST exemption claimed
Pls list down Notification No under which exemption was claimed
Pls put screen shot/entire notification in working folder

-If not, pls mention conditions not fulfilled.

If Not, please mention the reason for not issuing the Bill of Supply. This Needs to be Reported as Findings for the Clients

 -Name, Address and GSTIN of Supplier

 Update whether Client has been communicated about this thru an Email?

In order to check whether price is the sole consideration, review the agreement of major customers (minutely read "consideration" clause of agreement)

If the customer is a Centre/State Government, and Subsidy/Incentive is paid by the said Govt, then please check whether the Taxable Value includes the value of Subsidy/Incentive on which Tax is charged. 

If not then discuss this with your Senior.

Please check whether any Interest/ Penal Interest/ Penalty for delayed receipt of consideration is charged to the customer. 

If yes, then please check what documents are issued for demanding this amount. If Tax Invoice is issued then please check whether entire amount of Interest / Penal Interest/ Penalty are recovered from the customers. 

-If the entire demanded interest is recovered in the same period, then please check whether GST is paid/considered in Tax calculation for the Current month.
-If partial interest is recovered in the same period, then please check whether GST is paid/considered in Tax calculation for the Current month on the actual receipt.
-If no interest is recovered in the same period, then please check whether NO GST should be paid/considered in Tax calculation for the Current month.

- if Tax Invoice is not issued then please check the type of document issued and discuss the same with your senior (wherever the actual realisation of Interest/Penal Interest/Penalty happens then Tax Invoice should be the issued and Tax should be paid).
In respect of transactions with Related parties:
In order to identify the related parties of the customer, following steps to be undertaken:
- Reading of the Table/List of the Related Party disclosures from the Last Audited Financials
-Reading of the Fact Sheet of the Client.

-Name of the Companies which are operating form the customers premises are displayed at the reception of the Client's office. 
Any such names of companies observed there shall be cross-checked with the Sales or Purchase register to check whether any transaction is done with such companies.
If there are no transactions with such entities then discuss this with your seniors.

Whether the client has issued Credit Notes in the Current Period(Please review the signed copy of CN), 
If Yes please mention below the reasons for the Issuance of CN
(Credit Note can be issued for 3 reasons: Taxable Value charged on a higher side (Discount), Goods return & Deficiency in the Goods or Service supply.)

If CN is issued for discount then check the date of original sale invoice:
-If the said invoice date pertains to Current Year then please check the sales order/ contract with customers client as to whether the said agreement covers the issuance of discount.

-If the said invoice date pertains to Previous Financial Year then please check the review month should be of or before September. 

If not please discuss with the senior. 

-Please check whether the CN for discount are correctly reported in GSTR-1 as the recipient has to reduced its Input Tax Credit to this extent, hence reporting of CN in GSTR-1 will be reflected in the GSTR-2B of the recipient.

If the CN is for goods return:
-If the said invoice date pertains to Current Year then please check the sales order/ contract with customers client.

-If the said invoice date pertains to Previous Financial Year then please check the review month should be of or before September. If not please discuss with the senior.

-Please check whether the CN for goods return are correctly reported in GSTR-1.

If the CN is for deficiency (Goods rejection/Quality Issue/Inferior Service Quality, etc):
-If the original supply invoice date pertains to Current Year then please check the sales order/ contract with customers client.

-If the original supply invoice date pertains to Previous Financial Year then please check the review month should be of or before September. If not please discuss with the senior.

-Please check whether the CN for deficiency is correctly reported in GSTR-1.
